data.name: Spring Adventure
data.headline: Hop into fun with an unforgettable animal experience
data.description:
Spring Adventure is an engaging, seasonally themed program that invites children to explore the science of spring through animals, observation, and hands-on learning. Participants will meet live animal ambassadors—including a mammal, bird, amphibian, and invertebrate—take part in an age-appropriate STEM activity focused on butterfly conservation, and learn about life cycles, baby animals, and the changes plants and animals experience as winter turns to spring. The program encourages curiosity, critical thinking, and compassion for animals while reinforcing foundational science concepts in a fun, accessible way.

* **Schools:** Spring Adventure incorporates STEM concepts and aligns with Next Generation Science Standards for grades K–6. The program can be hosted on-site at our campus or brought directly to your classroom to reduce transportation costs and simplify scheduling. Schools are encouraged to call or email our Education Office to book; this allows us to reserve your program without upfront payment and invoice after the program concludes.

* **Girl Scouts:** this program can be customized to meet some of the “Between Earth and Sky” journey requirements for Daisies.

highlight_box.title: Spring into this seasonal adventure while it's available
highlight_box.description: Ideal for school classes, Scout outings, or playgroups, this egg-citing program combines hands-on animal encounters, a STEM activity, and lessons on animal life cycles and springtime changes.

data.highlights:
Spring Adventure brings the season to life by helping children observe real animals as examples of growth and change. Meeting a mammal, bird, amphibian, and invertebrate allows participants to compare life cycles and adaptations across very different species.

Hands-on learning is at the heart of this program. Children actively participate in age-appropriate STEM activities that encourage curiosity, problem-solving, and scientific thinking rather than passive listening.

The program also emphasizes compassion and respect for animals. By interacting with live animal ambassadors in a structured, supportive setting, participants learn how animals grow, behave, and depend on humans to make thoughtful, caring choices.

Designed for flexibility, Spring Adventure adapts to different ages, group sizes, and learning environments. Whether hosted on-site or in the classroom, the experience remains engaging, educational, and memorable.
data.itinerary: Animal presentations are 15 minute blocks and the STEM activity is a 30 minute block. General flow involves meeting the animals first then doing the activity, but this order can vary based on Instructor discretion.

meeting_point.address: 6447 Helen Woodward Way Rancho Santa Fe, CA US 92067

data.what_is_included:
90-minute programs include:
Interactions with 4 animals plus a STEM activity. Kids will interact with the following animals, which vary depending on location.
* **Onsite:** mini horse, chicken, frog, Madagascar hissing cockroach
* **Offsite:** guinea pig, dove, frog, Madagascar hissing cockroach

60-minute programs include:
Either interactions with 3 animals plus a STEM activity, or interactions with 4 animals and directions to do the STEM activity on your own (supplies not included). Kids will interact with the following animals, which vary depending on location.
* **Onsite:** mini horse, chicken, frog 
* **Offsite:** guinea pig, dove, frog

data.cancellation_notes:
- We operate rain or shine.
- Canceling 31+ days prior: Will result in a refund of 75% of the paid value.
- Canceling within 30 days of your scheduled event: Will result in no refund.
- Rescheduling 31+ days prior: Will result in a fee of 30% of the paid value.
- We will allow your program to be rescheduled without a penalty for up to 3 business days once it has been booked. We are not able to reschedule within 30 days of your scheduled event and you will not receive a refund.
data.booking_notes:
#We are looking forward to seeing you!
#CHECK-IN PROCEDURE
Meet at Education lobby to check in, at which point you will be directed back to the main meeting space for your program at one of our indoor classrooms or playgrounds. Plan to arrive 10 minutes before your program start time. Late arrival results in a shorter program with less time for animal interaction.

#PROGRAM EXPECTATIONS
To prepare children for live animal presentations at Helen Woodward Animal Center, please read and share the following before you arrive:
* All participants, regardless of age, should wear closed-toed shoes.
* Please remain with the group at all times. Some areas of the Center are restricted to staff access only.
* Food is only permitted in our Park or Pollinator event spaces.
* Not all animals can be pet. Your guide will invite you to pet when available.
* Animals are very sensitive to and easily startled by loud, high-pitched sounds and fast movement. Help children act respectfully around the animals by keeping "voices low and feet slow." For this reason flash photography is also prohibited.
data.check_in_details: Our Instructors will be expecting your arrival, but may not immediately be out there to greet you if they are finishing room and animal preparation, especially if you arrive early. In that scenario, send the group leader to our Education Lobby to check in and office staff will assist you. You will then be directed back to a classroom or a playground to use before the program begins.
data.pricing:
Pricing is set per child and adult, so total costs vary based on final group size. Babies 1 year or younger are free.

When booking, do you best estimation of child and adult head count. Day of, we will do a final head count and settle total costs.

* Schools should call us to book the program so we can bypass the fees at registration and send an invoice once the program is complete and has an accurate headcount.
data.special_requirements:
* Must be at least 5-years old to pet reptiles.
* Children must be accompanied by an adult. We suggest a 1:5 ratio (1 adult for every 5 children).
data.restrictions:
* **Outreaches**: Only available for schools. We do not visit people's residences.
* **Shoes**: For safety reasons, closed-toed shoes only. No sandals allowed.
* **Drawstrings**: For safety reasons, drawstrings (hoodies, pants or shorts) should not be worn on the playground.
* **Pets**: No pets are allowed on the campgrounds. There are no exceptions to this safety policy. Cannot leave pets alone in vehicles.
* **Toys, books, stuffed animals, etc.**: These may get soiled, broken, or lost—best to leave at home.
* **Sharp objects**: For safety purposes please leave anything that is a sharp or hazardous at home.
